(ns shop.cart
  "A shopping cart: items with prices, discounts and tax."
  (:require [clojure.string :as str]))

;; Tax rates by country, kept in one place so tests can override them.
(def rates {"PL" 0.23 "DE" 0.19 "US" 0.0})

(defn new-cart
  "Creates an empty cart for a country."
  [country]
  {:items [] :discount 0 :country (or country "PL")})

(defn add-item
  "Adds an item; a second add of the same sku bumps the quantity."
  ([cart sku price] (add-item cart sku price 1))
  ([cart sku price qty]
   (let [idx (first (keep-indexed (fn [i line] (when (= (:sku line) sku) i)) (:items cart)))]
     (if idx
       (update-in cart [:items idx :qty] + qty)
       (update cart :items conj {:sku sku :price price :qty qty})))))

(defn remove-item [cart sku]
  (update cart :items (fn [items] (vec (remove #(= (:sku %) sku) items)))))

(defn subtotal
  "Sum of line totals before discount and tax."
  [cart]
  (->> (:items cart)
       (map (fn [{:keys [price qty]}] (* price qty)))
       (reduce + 0)))

(defn total [cart]
  (let [base (max 0 (- (subtotal cart) (:discount cart)))
        rate (get rates (:country cart) 0.0)
        raw  (* base (+ 1 rate))]
    (/ (Math/round (* raw 100)) 100.0)))

(defn apply-coupon [cart code]
  (let [code (str/trim code)]
    (cond
      (= code "HALF") (assoc cart :discount (quot (subtotal cart) 2))
      (re-matches #"FIX\d+" code) (assoc cart :discount (min (parse-long (subs code 3)) (subtotal cart)))
      :else cart)))
